text: 央行李伟：聚焦国际科技创新中心三大核心功能建设，争取超长期特别国债等支持 优化科技成果转化金融服务，将重点发展研发中断保险等创新产品。
text_en: PBOC's Li Wei: Focus on building the three core functions of an international science and technology innovation center, seek support including ultra-long special treasury bonds; optimize financial services for commercialization of scientific and technological achievements, with emphasis on developing innovative products such as R&D interruption insurance.
